# A mentor can learn the wrong lesson

During supported practice the mentor apologized for a slow visitor and showed how to move the queue along. The newcomer copied the apology. We need to demonstrate whose comfort takes priority, not merely the sequence of buttons. [[Listening]] might help us discuss the encounter without pretending that a visitor who takes longer is a service defect.
